message: もう一度

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Good grief, how illogical...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel, what's wrong?」

name: Azel
message: 「There is nothing I can do」

name: Azel
message: 「Why is Prier always sold out of Vandine Jelly at the most crucial times?」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Even if you ask me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I know! Come on over to the Student Council room」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「We've got a whole stockpile of Vandine Jelly」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that true!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it's provided as an operating expense so we have something quick to eat when meetings get bogged down」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone keeps coming up with great ideas, though, so the stash hasn't gone down at all」

name: Synn
message: 「And Lolotte doesn't seem to like that jelly much anyway」

name: Azel
message: 「Naturally. Considering how much she eats」

name: Synn
message: 「So we have plenty to spare--you can take as much as you want, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's free!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd rather you take it, Azel, than let it sit around collecting dust. The Student Council has to be useful to everyone」
When I brought Azel along and returned to the Student Council room--

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yo, welcome back」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Missus, the master brought a guest home! Two more teas, please!」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaa!? Hold on, Takahashi-san! Why are you looking at me when you say that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, she's right!」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, she makes a fair point. You are the vice president, are you not, Dear Sister? Does that not make you the Student Council president's better half?」

name: Misa
message: 「Grr! In my heart, I'm the true Student Council President!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「A secret loving wife in the vice president, and an uninvited doting wife in Nana-chan, huh~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun has two things that are way too good for him~ Give one of them to me~」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uhh...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hold on. I shall not hand my sister over to Lady Sacchin, you hear?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I don't want something like that anyway~」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? What do you mean, 'something like that'!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my? Ahahaha... I-If it's tea you want, I'll brew some, okay?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Thanks a bunch, I'll take a refill while you're at it. Ria's tea is the best, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please give me seconds on the tea sweets♪」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Everyone, why are you still hanging around the Student Council room? And there are even more people here now!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're supposed to be heading straight out to start field research for the Holy Night Festival...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha! On the day exams are over and we're finally free from the gloom of test results, I wanna take a little detour!」

name: Ria
message: 「Mhm, mhm, that's really important♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Have a seat too, Azel-san. I'll brew some extra special tea right now.」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't need any. I merely came to pick up the jelly.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, that stuff? Hold on a second.」
Misa opens the mini-fridge and takes out an assortment of Vandine Jelly.

name: Misa
message: 「The expiration date is... around this time next year. There shouldn't be any problem giving them to Azel-san.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!? That jelly doesn't taste good at all, you know.」

name: Azel
message: 「Doesn't matter, I can still get the nutrients.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Nope, it matters a whole lot, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Kids our age grow up much better when we eat things we actually find delicious, don't you think?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why don't you stop forcing yourself and eat properly too, Azel-han? If you do, you'll be nice and big by this time next year.」

name: Ria
message: 「Next year, huh...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe, I feel like even after I go to college, I'll still be acting as an advisor to the Student Council♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「At that time, I might just be right beside Rii-a as well. After all, I intend to keep doing as I please for quite a while yet.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, by next year I'll have become the Student Council President--legally, of course! Prepare yourselves, alright?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, normally it'd be one of the current first-years.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's this, what's this, talking about the future?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What should I do? I don't have anything I wanna research in college, and besides, I don't have the brains to get in anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I knew it, I'm gonna be the proprietress of Yuugiri-an!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Do you even have a chef's license?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh-heh! To qualify for the chef's license exam, you just need two or more years of practical experience!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've been the poster girl of Yuugiri-an since before I could even remember. So I'm totally qualified!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, if it's just taking the exam, I suppose you can take it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whether I become a second-year or a third-year, I want to keep being part of the Student Council.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a declaration of war, Shio! Accept the challenge!」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm? Lady Lolotte's spirit is admirable, yet how does that translate into a contest with myself?」

name: Misa
message: 「My successor is obviously going to be you! Go and win the seat of the next Student Council President!」

name: Shio
message: 「Kuhii~ I could never handle such a monumental duty~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoheh? If a shrine maiden becomes the president, then Ryuusei Academy's uniform will turn into shrine maiden outfits, won't it? How exciting, sparkle, sparkle~\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Umm. I think that might be impossible?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I wanna become a bride~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sacchin, don't just casually steal the spotlight like that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe~ I wouldn't mind being Nana-chan's groom either, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way, no way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha. Azel, do you have a dream of what you want to be?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Wishing alone makes nothing come true.」

name: Azel
message: 「This world is...」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm going home!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? She left? Wasn't she here to pick up her jelly?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauah!? Welcome back.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I forgot the jelly.」

name: Misa
message: 「Here you go.」

name: Azel
message: 「...My thanks.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, you.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. Don't ask me about dreams!」

name: Azel
message: 「How could I possibly know my own future when I can't even figure out the one person standing right in front of me!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Eeeh? I don't really get it, but you just have to fall in love again~」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no recollection of ever falling in love!!」
Holding an armload of Vandine Jelly, Azel finally made her exit for real this time.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin, what was that all about?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoopsie, I just threw out a random guess to bait her, and it looks like I hit the bullseye~」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't get it at all.」
I sit down and drink two portions of the tea Ria-senpai brewed for us.
Everyone chats idly about what Azel might be doing around this time next year.
Strangely enough, despite how distinctive she is, no clear image came to mind...
